name: Merton myopic optimal risky fraction
description: The Merton objective π(μ−r) − (γσ²/2)π² has unique critical point and global maximiser π* = (μ−r)/(γσ²) with value (μ−r)²/(2γσ²), expressed through the single-asset risk contribution.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Choice.Performance.MertonFraction

open MathFin
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped NNReal ENNReal

/-- The Merton objective π(μ−r) − (γσ²/2)π² has unique critical point and global maximiser π* = (μ−r)/(γσ²) with value (μ−r)²/(2γσ²), expressed through the single-asset risk contribution. -/
theorem mf_portfolio_merton_myopic_fraction (γ μ r σ : ℝ) (hγ : 0 < γ) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    (∀ π : ℝ, riskContribution (Finset.univ : Finset Unit) (fun _ _ => σ ^ 2) (fun _ => π) ()
        = π ^ 2 * σ ^ 2) ∧
    (∀ π : ℝ, mertonObjective γ μ r σ π = π * (μ - r) - (γ / 2) *
        riskContribution (Finset.univ : Finset Unit) (fun _ _ => σ ^ 2) (fun _ => π) ()) ∧
    (∀ π : ℝ, IsRiskParity (Finset.univ : Finset Unit) (fun _ _ => σ ^ 2) (fun _ => π)) ∧
    (∀ π : ℝ, HasDerivAt (mertonObjective γ μ r σ) (μ - r - γ * σ ^ 2 * π) π) ∧
    (∀ π : ℝ, HasDerivAt (mertonObjective γ μ r σ) 0 π ↔ π = (μ - r) / (γ * σ ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ π : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => μ - r - γ * σ ^ 2 * x) (-(γ * σ ^ 2)) π) ∧
    -(γ * σ ^ 2) < 0 ∧
    (∀ π : ℝ, mertonObjective γ μ r σ π ≤
        mertonObjective γ μ r σ ((μ - r) / (γ * σ ^ 2))) ∧
    mertonObjective γ μ r σ ((μ - r) / (γ * σ ^ 2)) = (μ - r) ^ 2 / (2 * γ * σ ^ 2) :=
  MathFin.merton_myopic_fraction γ μ r σ hγ hσ
